quests.title: The top step
quests.ask: Build the top row: its single gem, in the top-left corner. Then go back to the left edge, one row down, and put that row's first gem.
quests.nudge: How many gems does the first pass put? How far is it back to the left edge after them?

quests.title: The second step
quests.ask: Finish the second row, one gem longer than the first. Then go back to the left edge, one row down, and put that row's first gem.
quests.nudge: Does the way back to the left edge get longer from row to row?

quests.title: Every step one longer
quests.ask: Build the whole staircase, each row one gem longer than the row above.
quests.nudge: Which number already changes every time round the outer loop?
